name: Cloudflare Web Search API
description: Returns structured web search results from Exa, Linkup, or Ceramic through Cloudflare's AI Gateway via REST or a Workers binding, for agents that need live web context.

skills.name: Multiple Search Providers
skills.description: Switches between Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup with one provider parameter and a shared result format.

skills.name: REST API
skills.description: Sends search queries from any backend and receives titles, URLs, and descriptions for model context.

skills.name: Workers Binding
skills.description: Calls env.AI.websearch() from a Cloudflare Worker through the AI binding.

skills.name: Bring Your Own Key
skills.description: Uses your own provider API key instead of AI Gateway Unified Billing credits.

skills.name: Web Search as a Tool
skills.description: Exposes web search as a tool that models can call during inference.
